**Senior Back\-end Developer – Electronic Access Control**

  

**Build the backend that connects the future of secure access.**

  

As a **Senior Back\-end Developer**, you will join our skilled, international team of developers based in Stockholm, dedicated to building next\-generation products and access control solutions that enable identity, authentication and access experiences for customers worldwide.


**Why this role matters**

  

At ASSA ABLOY, technology plays a direct role in creating safer, more open environments. Your work will help make sure different product components can communicate and work together reliably — turning individual technologies into complete access solutions.


This is a role for someone who enjoys more than simply implementing requirements. You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to architecture, solve challenging backend and integration problems, and continuously improve both the software and the way the team works.


**The role**

  

You’ll join a small and strongly connected team working in a highly self\-organised agile environment. The team values close collaboration, open discussion and learning from one another, with approaches such as pair programming and mob programming forming part of how you work together.


You’ll take ownership of backend development and integrations, from designing solutions through to implementation, testing and continuous improvement. You’ll also contribute to technical discussions and decisions, while having the independence to explore problems and find solutions before bringing others in.


**What you’ll work on**

  

* **Build and evolve backend services** — develop high\-quality software using Golang and modern software engineering practices, with a focus on distributed systems and product connectivity.
* **Develop APIs and integrations** — create and maintain REST APIs and modern integration patterns that connect different product components.
* **Shape technical solutions** — contribute to software architecture, object\-oriented design and decisions around scalable, maintainable solutions.
* **Strengthen software quality** — work with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and code reviews to help deliver reliable software.
* **Solve complex problems** — troubleshoot and improve existing solutions while looking for practical ways to make the product and development process better.
* **Work closely with the team** — collaborate through pair and mob programming, share knowledge and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.

**What will help you succeed**

  

* **5\+ years of backend software development experience**, including designing and delivering production\-grade applications.
* **Hands\-on experience with Golang as a programming language**, together with experience building distributed systems, APIs or backend services.
* **Solid understanding of software architecture and object\-oriented design**, including REST APIs and modern integration patterns.
* **Experience with modern development practices**, particularly CI/CD, automated testing and code reviews.
* **A collaborative and curious mindset** — you enjoy learning from others, sharing knowledge and remaining open to new ideas, technologies and perspectives. You see change as an opportunity to improve products, processes and team effectiveness.

  

**Nice to have:** Some experience with the .NET ecosystem.


**Why ASSA ABLOY**

  

You’ll join a global organisation where you can work on technology with a real\-world purpose, while having the trust and freedom to shape how you contribute. You’ll be part of a small team where collaboration is close, ideas are welcome and continuous improvement is part of everyday work.

  

* **Meaningful mission** — Build software that helps connect secure access solutions used in real\-world environments around the world.
* **Innovation \& scale** — Develop your expertise across distributed systems, backend services, integrations and modern software engineering within a global technology organisation.
* **Autonomy \& trust** — Work in a self\-organised team where you’re encouraged to take ownership, explore solutions and influence technical decisions.
* **Growth \& development** — Learn from experienced colleagues, contribute across the technology stack and continuously develop your technical and problem\-solving skills.
* **Work–life balance** — Work from Stockholm in a hybrid setup, within a Scandinavian culture built around collaboration, trust and sustainable ways of working.

**Ready to build the connections behind secure access?**

  

Apply today and join the team in shaping the backend and integrations behind the next generation of Electronic Access Control.


We review applications continuously and will be moving forward with suitable candidates throughout the process. To make sure your personal data is safe, we don't review applications sent by email or post. If you have any questions about the role or the process, please contact Léa Rein, Senior Talent Acquisition Business Partner.


Depending on the risk profile for the role, a background screening may need to be performed. Final candidates may therefore be subject to a background screening. The performance of a background check is subject to consent and based on our Applicant Privacy Notice.

  



**We are the ASSA ABLOY Group**
  

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.


As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Etsimme nyt tiimiimme kokenutta full-stack -kehittäjää, joka haluaa soveltaa osaamistaan vaativissa, korkean turvallisuustason ympäristöissä.

Etsimme Solitalle kokeneita full-stack-ohjelmistokehittäjiä erityisesti Helsingin ja Tampereen seuduille DefSec –alueen asiakasprojekteihin. Tapauskohtaisesti sijaintisi voi olla myös muilla toimistopaikkakunnillamme (Turku, Oulu, Jyväskylä, Lahti, Pori, Kuopio, Joensuu ja Vaasa), mikäli Helsinkiin matkustaminen onnistuu tarvittaessa säännöllisesti.

Pääset työskentelemään ohjelmistokehitysprojekteissa, joissa rakennetaan turvallisia, toimintavarmoja ja pitkäikäisiä digitaalisia ratkaisuja DefSec-toimialalle. Näissä hankkeissa teknologialla on suora yhteys esimerkiksi yhteiskunnan turvallisuuteen, tilannekuvan muodostamiseen, viranomaisten yhteistyöhön ja kriittisten operaatioiden sujuvuuteen. Solitalla DefSec -toimialan tekeminen kattaa esimerkiksi turvalliset digitaaliset alustat, korkean turvallisuustason operatiiviset järjestelmät, AI-pohjaisen analytiikan ja erilaiset tilannekuvaratkaisut.

Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa esimerkiksi operatiivisten turvallisuus- ja tilannekuvajärjestelmien kehittämistä, viranomaisyhteistyötä tukevien alustojen modernisointia, navigointiin ja autonomisiin järjestelmiin liittyviä ratkaisuja sekä tekoälyn hyödyntämisen edellytysten rakentamista korkean turvallisuustason ympäristöihin. Etsimme yhdessä projektivalikoimastamme sinulle kiinnostavan kokonaisuuden, jossa pääset yhdistämään modernin full-stack-kehityksen, konsultatiivisen työotteen ja korkean turvallisuustason vaatimukset.

Millaisessa roolissa työskentelet?

Ohjelmistokehittäjänä olet mukana koko kehityskaarella ideasta toteutukseen, jatkokehitykseen ja ylläpitoon asti. Suunnittelet, rakennat ja kehität turvallisia, skaalautuvia ja helposti ylläpidettäviä ohjelmistoratkaisuja asiakkaidemme tarpeisiin. DefSec-projekteissa tämä tarkoittaa usein järjestelmiä, joiden tulee toimia luotettavasti vaativissa ympäristöissä, integroitua osaksi laajempia kokonaisuuksia ja täyttää korkeat tietoturvan, toimintavarmuuden ja ylläpidettävyyden vaatimukset.

Roolisi ytimessä on työskennellä teknisessä roolissa konsultatiivisella otteella: ymmärrät asiakkaan toiminnallisia ja liiketoiminnallisia tarpeita ja käännät ne fiksuiksi teknisiksi ratkaisuiksi. Arjessa työskentelet sujuvasti niin backendin kuin frontendinkin parissa. Automaatio, testaus, DevOps-ajattelu ja jatkuva toimitus ovat meillä luonnollinen osa tekemistä.

Tehtävän painotukset voivat vaihdella kokemuksesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaan, ja rooli tarjoaa myös hyviä mahdollisuuksia kasvattaa omaa osaamista. Arjessa osallistut ominaisuuksien kehittämiseen ja suunnitteluun sekä ratkot teknisiä haasteita yhdessä tiimin kanssa. Kokeneempana kehittäjänä otat enemmän vastuuta laajemmista kokonaisuuksista, teknisestä suunnasta ja ratkaisujen laadusta, samalla tukien sekä tiimiä että asiakasta käytännön tekemisessä.

Keskustelemme kanssasi roolin tarkemmista painotuksista ja vastuun laajuudesta kokemuksesi ja kiinnostuksesi perusteella. Riippuen roolin kokonaisuudesta, kuukausipalkkasi sijoittuu tyypillisesti 4700–5600 euron välille. Palkka on kiinteä kuukausipalkka, ja lisäksi käytössäsi ovat Solitan kattavat luontoisedut.

Millaista osaamista toivomme sinulta?

Avenga is an international engineering firm helping businesses operate with AI at the core. With 6,000+ experts worldwide, we combine engineering expertise with AI-native thinking to turn ambitious ideas into real-world impact across industries, technologies, and markets.

At the core of the role

You will join a FinTech project focused on financial services, built around a modern, distributed architecture. The platform uses an event-sourcing and microservice-oriented approach, supporting scalable and reliable processing of financial data and business events.

Core Skills You’ll Bring

10+ years of software development experience with a strong emphasis on systems engineering
Strong proficiency in C#/.NET (Java acceptable)
Proven experience designing and building APIs
Solid background in distributed messaging systems and event-driven architectures
Hands-on experience with Pulsar or Kafka, including event streaming and event sourcing patterns at scale
Experience implementing financial calculations, pricing engines, or quantitative models
Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB
Familiarity with telemetry and observability tools such as Sentry, Datadog, or Elasticsearch
Experience building and scaling component libraries or design systems
Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar
Strong communication skills and a proven track record of cross-functional collaboration

Nice-to-have

Familiarity with fixed income or securities pricing concepts
Familiarity with Databricks or Lakehouse architectures
Hands-on experience with SignalR or WebSocket-based systems

Design and develop high-quality services using C#/.NET or Java
Build and maintain ASP.NET service-side applications with a focus on scalability and long-term reliability
Work with distributed messaging frameworks and event-driven architectures to power high-throughput
systems
Design, implement, and operate event streaming and event sourcing solutions using Pulsar or Kafka, including topic design, consumer group management, and replay strategies
Develop and optimize data solutions using NoSQL databases such as MongoDB
Integrate observability platforms such as Datadog or Elasticsearch to support system monitoring and diagnostics
Implement telemetry and monitoring best practices using Sentry or equivalent tools
Collaborate effectively across teams to deliver features and align on technical direction
Build reusable, testable infrastructure and uphold consistent coding standards across teams
Foster a culture of engineering excellence and continuous improvement across the team
Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude to improve productivity and code quality
